title: These greenhouse-gas sources have trotters and snouts
abstract: Emissions linked to global warming are higher at sites where feral pigs disturb the soil.

title: A guide to emotional intelligence in the lab
abstract: Learning how to manage your feelings can help you to tackle some tricky situations at work, say organizational psychologists.

title: Mutating every DNA letter of a genome shows surprising effects — and the limits of AI
abstract: Top artificial-intelligence models failed to predict the biological consequences of rewriting a virus's entire DNA code.

abstract: US funding uncertainty was a key factor for several of the researchers heading to Canada. Observers predict more will follow.

abstract: The pace of academia rarely slows, so researchers should make time to celebrate major career milestones.

title: A machine learning method for calculating highly localized protein stabilities
authors: Chenlin Lu, Kyle C. Weber, Savannah K. McBride, et al.
abstract: PFNet is a machine learning model that infers residue-level protein stabilities from conventional hydrogen exchange-mass spectrometry data, transforming a widely used structural biology technique into a scalable tool for quantitative protein ensemble analysis.

title: Ultrathin nano-layered boron nitride stabilizing perovskite quantum dot-based light-emitting diodes
authors: Jindi Wang, Hongdan Ren, Bo Cai, et al.
abstract: Perovskite quantum dot light-emitting diodes are promising for lighting and displays, but poor operational stability limits their use. Wang et al. added an ultrathin boron nitride interlayer to suppress defects, ion migration, and heat sensitivity, improving efficiency and lifetime.

title: Coulombic surface dipole trapping ionomer for efficient proton exchange membrane fuel cells
authors: Siyuan Wang, Fanpeng Kong, Zhengyang Bao, et al.
abstract: Low-platinum fuel cells need catalyst layers that move protons and oxygen efficiently, but uneven ionomer placement limits performance. Here, the authors report a cobalt single-atom dipole coating which guides the ionomer, protects platinum surfaces and boosts power and durability.

title: Efficacy of everolimus and letrozole with or without ribociclib in recurrent endometrial cancer: a phase 2 randomized clinical trial
authors: Jeffrey A. How, Shannon N. Westin, Melissa Pham, et al.
abstract: Therapeutic options for recurrent endometrial cancer (rEC) are limited. Here, the authors present a randomized phase 2 clinical trial comparing the combination of mTOR and aromatase inhibitors (everolimus and letrozole) with or without the CDK4/6 inhibitor, ribociclib, in patients with rEC.

title: CRACD loss drives hypoxia-induced immune escape in gastric cancer
authors: Yoojeong Seo, Jinho Jang, Kyung-Pil Ko, et al.
abstract: Mucinous gastric adenocarcinoma is an aggressive subtype of gastric cancer with limited therapeutic options and poorly understood mechanisms of immune evasion. Here, the authors show that loss of the actin polymerization regulator CRACD promotes mucinous plasticity and immune escape by driving hypoxia-dependent upregulation of PD-L1.
